environment.host: WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 on Windows 11 (the Windows host cannot build these environments)

protocol.why_not_the_local_cache: The ingestion cache stores each project as a partial clone (partialclonefilter=blob:none, promisor remote): commits and trees are present but file blobs are not, so cloning from it fails with 'unable to read sha1 file' for every file.
protocol.interpreter: the exact Python minor version BugsInPy records per bug
protocol.test_injection: BugsInPy adds the bug-revealing test IN the fix commit, so the buggy revision does not contain it. The protocol is buggy SOURCE with the fixed revision's TEST FILE; without injection pytest reports 'no tests ran' (exit 4) or an older passing test.
protocol.setuptools_pin: setuptools<70. Modern setuptools no longer ships pkg_resources, which these 2019-era projects import during their own build.
protocol.pytest_exit_code_policy: Only exit 1 is a test failure. Exit 2/3/4/5 means pytest could not run the test and is recorded as infrastructure failure, never as a reproduced defect.
